column2: A white glazed New York subway station tile wall: rows of small white rectangular tiles with dark grout, a deep red and gold mosaic name band across the top that says SAME DIFFERENCE in mosaic letters, a decorative mosaic border, blue steel column bases, a few old torn posters with eye flower faces, a subway map frame, an emergency exit sign, grime near the floor.

The wall of a grand Beaux Arts railroad terminal concourse: honey coloured limestone with carved cornices and pilasters, brass grilles, a tall arched window with iron mullions, a marble wainscot, a brass ticket window with a sign that says SAME DIFFERENCE, framed vintage travel posters where every face is an eye flower.

The wall of a New York corner bodega, floor to ceiling shelves crammed with colourful snacks, canned goods, cereal boxes, coffee cans, paper towels, a hanging rack of chips, a handwritten price sign that says N3W, a glowing drink fridge with glass doors, a lottery poster with an eye flower face, a cat sitting on a shelf.

The wall of an old New York police precinct interview room: pale institutional green painted cinder block, a dark green wainscot, a metal ventilation grille, a wall clock, a framed notice board with typed notices, a two way mirror frame edge, a mounted old telephone, scuffs and chipped paint, a sign that says NEW YORKERS.

A wall of warm herringbone Guastavino terracotta tiles in a vaulted New York railroad terminal undercroft, with an arched alcove, brass lamps, a carved stone pier base, a small brass plaque that says WHISPER.

A tall red brick New York apartment building facade seen perfectly straight on: rows of tall windows, some lit warm and some dark, black iron fire escapes zig zagging across, a stone cornice, a ground floor storefront with an awning that says NEW YORKERS, window air conditioners, a water stain.

The wall of a New York subway mezzanine: white tile with a green mosaic band, a row of turnstiles, a token booth with a sign that says SAME DIFFERENCE, a subway map, a STAND CLEAR OF THE CLOSING DOORS poster with an eye flower face, overhead signs with route circles.

The wall of a stylish New York museum gift shop: tall white display shelves packed with art books, framed prints, tote bags with an eye flower print, mugs, postcards on a rack, small sculptures, neat spot lighting, a sign that says THE GIFT SHOP.

The interior wall of a New York subway car: brushed stainless steel panels with rivets, an advertising card rack above the windows full of colourful ad cards with eye flower faces, a door with a window, a route map strip, a grab bar.
